versions.changelog:
Initial release of work-productivity-skillscan-security-workflow-helper.

- Launches a skill for generating practical, SkillScan-style security and productivity workflows based on validated demand from Agent users.
- Supports workflow creation for bug fixing, setup hardening, reliability improvements, and adjacent skill development.
- Outputs include tailored artifacts, reusable checklists, automation outlines, and validation notes.
- Workflow emphasizes actionable, local-hardware-friendly implementations and decision support.
- Triggered by common productivity and security keywords or user requests for SkillScan-style assistance.
